project.description: The design substrate: two trees and a projection. A sealed physical tree (Target) owns the CSS — the property partition, the states a medium can show, the template and the sheet; an open semantic tree (Semantic) owns the meaning — a branch is an interface, a leaf a record in whoever's crate needs it. A DesignClass is one semantic leaf projected onto one physical leaf; a Design is a provider per class — bindings, a body, or silence — and whatever a provider delegates to, the served sheet is flat. Depends on homing-core - a semantic leaf is a CssGroup, a design class is a CssClass, so the module graph serves them unchanged - and on nothing else. Components and designs both depend on this, and never on each other; core never depends on this.
